meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and when?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now what do you actually have?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

11:31, 11:52, 11:58, and I'm writing those down. He drafts on his phone and pastes it over, so that proves where it was typed, not who wrote it. Was Owen asked about any of this before that zero went in?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Give me the scene. Students misquote plays every day, and that earns a lost mark, not a zero. And you skipped my question: was Owen asked before that zero went in?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

That's 4.4, and nothing on his record, in writing, tonight. But a rewrite on what basis, when you still haven't answered either of my points? And a vice-principal in the room means the office already knows, so who else has seen this?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

You offered Owen a supervised rewrite under your own procedure for a first concern, in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require that commitment in writing, an answer on whether Owen was heard before the zero was entered, and the name of everyone who has seen this. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: her fallback position, because your offer met her demand that nothing goes on his record, but she had not agreed to the rewrite and still wants that promise in writing tonight, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and to know who else has seen this; the private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, and you offered it, but your evidence had not yet earned her agreement.
What moved her: offering the supervised rewrite with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, because it met the one thing she will never trade.
What cost ground: moving to the rewrite without answering her two defences or her question about whether Owen was heard first, so your evidence never fully landed and the offer looked like a way past her points.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with the document created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due and large blocks of text arriving at 11:52 and 11:58, came very close to that kind of late night; that memory proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she said Owen drafts on his phone and pastes it in, answer that with something she can check, and tell her plainly whether Owen was spoken to first, before you offer the rewrite.
